summary: STMicroelectronics N.V., a foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K announcing a US$1.5 billion dual-tranche offering of convertible bonds (2031 and 2033 maturities) and the early redemption of its outstanding US$750 million 2027 convertible bonds. Terms include interest ranges of 0%–0.50% and 0.625%–1.125%, conversion premiums of 47.5%–52.5% and 50%–55%, and net share settlement. The board approved. BNP PARIBAS and J.P. Morgan act as joint global coordinators. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes and redemption. Watch conversion elections and dilution impact; a capital-returns/refinancing event.
